notes: v661 - two corrections to the cost message. First, it put a $6 FEE and a percentage side by side, which made the percentage look like a brokerage rate. They are different things: brokerage is a flat $3 each way that you are charged, while the SPREAD is not a fee at all - it is the gap between the buy price and the sell price in the market. On a 17-cent share the price steps are half a cent, so at the same moment you might buy at 17.5c and only be able to sell at 17.0c. Nobody charges you that half cent; you lose it in the prices. The message now says which is which. Second, and more importantly, the spread cost was OVERSTATED - it assumed crossing the spread both ways. Your dip order rests below the market and does not cross to get in, which is the whole point of a patient limit entry, so only the sell crosses. The figure is now counted one way instead of two, which roughly halves it. Display only; no scores or rules changed. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
